proposed_comments.title: Preserve keyboard focus visuals on Home rows
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve keyboard focus visuals on Home rows

**Severity:** `medium`

The explicit style replaces the toolkit's implicit `SettingsCard` style, but it does not carry over `UseSystemFocusVisuals` (whose default is false) or `FocusVisualMargin`, and this template defines no focused visual state of its own. As a result, keyboard users can tab to a Home row without any visible focus indicator. Preserve the two focus setters from `DefaultSettingsCardStyle` in this specialized style.

```suggestion
                <Setter Property="UseSystemFocusVisuals" Value="True" />
                <Setter Property="FocusVisualMargin" Value="-3" />
```
